comment: No module in this plugin implements dataToJson, so the SHAPE selection, which lives only in a runtime int, is lost when a patch is saved and reloaded and comes back as shape 1. The manual describes the four shapes qualitatively; the times and the -30dB floor here are read from the shapes[4] table at TL_Pump.cpp:55-61 and from minGain at :41. The manual lists the stereo inputs as L and R without mentioning that R falls back to L when unpatched. Every jack is read with getVoltage(), so nothing is polyphonic.
